In applied mathematics, '''Loubignac iteration''' is an [[iterative method]] in [[finite element method]]s. It gives continuous [[stress field]]. It is named after Gilles Loubignac, who published the method in 1977.

* [https://arc.aiaa.org/doi/abs/10.2514/3.7464 Loubignac's paper]
